line.en: the weekly jazz night at esl on 9th street. doors at nine, the band from about half past ten. free entry, 21 and over.
line.de: der wöchentliche jazzabend im esl an der 9th street. einlass um neun, die band ab etwa halb elf. eintritt frei, ab 21.
line.tr: esl'de haftalık caz gecesi, 9th street'te. kapılar dokuzda, grup yaklaşık 22:30'da. giriş ücretsiz, 21 yaş ve üzeri.

sparks.why: Jazz Wednesday at ESL, 1230 9th St NW, weekly through late November 2026, doors 9pm, free, 21+ (washington.org listing).
